hero.desc: A website that integrates the entire operating workflow, from receiving Pre-Sales leads and managing classes to student attendance, timekeeping, and automated payroll & commission calculation.

features.heading: Core Feature Modules
features.desc: The EduCRM & Sales system fully solves the operational challenges of a modern training center.

items.title: 1. Advertising Source Management
items.desc: Accurately track every marketing channel (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Zalo OA, Website) to measure conversion rates and actual revenue generated from each source.

items.title: 2. Pre-Sales Lead Management
items.desc: Automatically assign leads to each sales consultant. Track needs, target students, rejection reasons, and "Close Deal" actions that convert leads into official students.

items.title: 3. Classes & Student Attendance
items.desc: Automatically assign students to classes after registration. Teachers and managers can take daily attendance, note attendance status, and view a visual class schedule.

items.title: 4. HR Management & Timekeeping
items.desc: Store employee records by position (Sales, Teacher, Admin), track daily timekeeping, and manage the number of dependents for tax purposes.

items.title: 5. Vietnamese Payroll & Commission Tax
items.desc: Automatically calculate Gross/NET pay, 3% sales commission, mandatory insurance contributions (SI 8%, UI 1%, HI 1.5%), and progressive personal income tax in line with Labor Law.

items.title: 6. Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
items.desc: Visual charts of revenue by class, advertising source breakdown, top-performing sales leaderboard, and analysis of the most common customer rejection reasons.

architecture.heading: A Modern, Easily Scalable Architecture
architecture.desc: Built on a React + TypeScript + Vite project structure combined with Tailwind CSS, the system is cleanly split into modules with a standard folder structure:

points.title: Modular Services & Hooks:
points.desc: Separates the API layer, Auth Context, and Custom Hooks.

points.title: Optimized UI:
points.desc: Uses Tailwind CSS combined with Chart.js for smooth rendering.

reviews.heading: Overall Review Summary
reviews.desc: The key strengths that make EduCRM a truly comprehensive center management system.

items.title: Excellent UX/UI Experience
items.desc: Intuitive interface, harmonious color scheme, and strong responsive support. Closing deals, taking student attendance, and timekeeping all run smoothly without interruption.

items.title: Standardized VN Tax & Insurance
items.desc: The system integrates an algorithm that automatically converts Gross to NET pay, deducting 8% SI, 1% UI, 1.5% HI, and applying the exact progressive personal income tax schedule.

items.title: Seamless Data Flow Between Stages
items.desc: Data flows seamlessly from Ad Source -> Lead Data -> Sales Revenue -> Student Class Placement -> Sales Commission, all on a single platform.
